items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: And Miss Lil was playing piano with Joe Oliver

ctx.x: But around 35th and State were you around that area?

I used to go around there and slip in the pool room and shoot proof or something like that, you understand what I mean? But you couldn't get in there? No, no, there wasn't no music around there. You see, it was 30, 40th and Cottage Grove, that's where Joe Oliver was playing. And Miss Lil was playing piano with Joe Oliver and Louis got in the band and she was a graduate of Wilberforce and she got in with Louis and taught Louis how to read, you know, how to read music and things like that. And after Louis started…
When you came back to New Orleans, you didn't start playing music right away? No, I learned how to play ukulele. Did you used to go around and listen to bands here? No. You must have been about 19.
